directional_accuracy.note: Raw returns after inverse scaling. PT p-values are diagnostics: non-overlap does not establish independence.

falsification.note: Same actual B4--B6 targets, scale-free loss; see refresh-control decomposition and achieved seed counts.

attention_amplification.note: Same features, Q/K inactive under uniform attention; active capacity differs. Historical dropout also differs.

raw_scale.note: RMSE in raw log-return units beside MSE in scaler space (§9.1).

coverage.note: Conditional on surviving continuous windows; gap causes unverified and missing outcomes unrecovered. See training_sample for achieved counts.

covariate.note: A(i,b) = alpha_i + beta1 b + beta2 coverage(i,b) + eps, clustered on origin, WCR one-sided (`D80`). This is root §9.2's covariate route, and it is the one that runs: the restriction below unbalances the panel and returns None.

coverage.restricted_unavailable_reason: restricting to well-covered blocks unbalances the panel, and beta1's reduction to the mean of within-slopes holds only on a balanced one. That the check cannot run IS the `D45` finding.

contrasts.note: Positive mean_diff means the LEFT arm is worse. Paired across the origins both arms were evaluated on, on RelMSE so no comparison crosses a sigma_g boundary (`D60i`), with the origin as the inferential unit (`D30`). Post-hoc and uncorrected for multiplicity (`D82`).
